preconditions.description: Input must contain integers n (number of tanks) and k (total allowed width increase) where 2 ≤ n ≤ 50 and 0 ≤ k ≤ 1000.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == 2 and all(len(line.split()) == int(stdin.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Input must have exactly n lines after the first line, each containing exactly n integers representing pipe widths.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(c) <= 10**6 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for c in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each pipe width must be a non-negative integer ≤ 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[i-1]) == 0 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for i in range(1, int(stdin.split()[0]) + 1))
preconditions.description: Diagonal entries (cii) must be 0, indicating no self-loops.

postconditions.description: Output must be a non-negative integer representing the maximum flow from tank 1 to tank n after increasing pipe widths by at most k units.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout) <= sum(min(int(c), int(c) + k) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for c in line.split())
postconditions.description: Output must not exceed the maximum possible flow achievable by increasing any subset of pipe widths by at most k units in total.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(c) + delta_c <= 10**6 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for c in line.split() for delta_c in [0, min(k, 10**6 - int(c))])
postconditions.description: Output must correspond to a valid configuration where no pipe width exceeds 10^6 after increasing by at most k units in total.
